front.title: Extensions to IS-IS for Advertising Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Relay Information

abstract.t:
Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) provides a method for generating shared symmetric keys between two QKD systems. Large-scale QKD networks commonly use trusted relay nodes to deliver key material across multiple QKD links.
to steer key-relay traffic through a sequence of trusted relay nodes. A critical prerequisite for this approach is the ability of collecting the QKD capability of the nodes and links in the network.
This document extends IS-IS by defining a new Application ID for QKD relay information within the GENINFO TLV [RFC6823]. This extension allows nodes to advertise their QKD relay informations and then collected by the QKD controller for QKD relay path calculation.
